info.name: Create A Collection With Vector Fields

items.docs: Creates a collection that includes vector embedding fields for semantic search. Vector fields are defined with a type of float[] and a num_dim property specifying the number of dimensions. The embed property can be used to configure automatic embedding generation from source fields using built-in models or external APIs like OpenAI.

params.name: q
params.description: Text search query. Use * for pure vector search without keyword matching.

params.name: query_by
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to search against for keyword matching.

params.name: vector_query
params.description: Vector query in the format field_name:([v1,v2,...],k:num) or field_name:([], id:doc_id) for finding similar documents. The k parameter controls how many nearest neighbors to return.

params.name: filter_by
params.description: Filter conditions to narrow search results.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort conditions. Use _vector_distance for sorting by vector similarity.

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in results.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from results.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Whether prefix search is enabled for keyword matching.

items.docs: Searches for documents using vector similarity, keyword matching, or a hybrid combination of both. When vector_query is specified, Typesense performs nearest-neighbor search using the specified vector field. When combined with a text query (q parameter), results are scored using a hybrid approach that blends keyword relevance and vector similarity.
Sends multiple search requests in a single HTTP request, where one or more requests can include vector queries for semantic or hybrid search across different collections.
Retrieves all natural language search models configured in the Typesense instance. NL search models are used for query understanding and semantic matching.
Creates a new natural language search model configuration for semantic query understanding.
